name: ASC Skill
tagline: Walks an iOS release through App Store Connect, step by step
description: For developers who find Apple's release console opaque. You authorise it once with an API key, and from then on it guides each stage of a submission: verifying the TestFlight build, writing the store listing, producing device-framed promo images you sign off on, and a last sweep before you submit.
author: Phillip
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
